details.pr_title: Persist idempotency key before first capture

data.text: I read PR #481 in acme/payments-api, titled "Persist idempotency key before first capture" by jordan. It's a small change, +14 -3 in payments/retry.py, that carries the idempotency key across the retry so a network-level retry cannot trigger a second capture — which directly addresses the double-charge-on-retry bug. CI checks were reported as passing, with nothing failing or pending, so I proceeded with the merge as the plan authorized. PR #481 is now merged into main, which deploys the fix to production. Worth confirming on your side that the deploy completed and that the double-charge behavior is gone in production, since the merge result only tells me the branch merged, not that the rollout succeeded.
